description.value: Plain Jane is a New Zealand-style ice cream shop that opened in the summer of 2024 in Vancouver's Hastings-Sunrise neighbourhood. They blend real frozen fruit to order into organic French vanilla ice cream base using a New Zealand technique, with a short, rotating seasonal menu. A dairy-free coconut ice cream (Nora's) is available for those avoiding dairy.
